prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent rear-view game character sprite. Image 1 is the approved character identity reference, Marin. Create the SAME character seen directly FROM BEHIND, facing away from the camera toward the road. Show only the back of the rounded deep navy blue needle-felt helmet and back of the creamy ivory coat/body, same wool fibers, original proportions, short arms and tiny feet. Turn the entire character 180 degrees; head aligned with body, absolutely NO looking back, NO eyes or face visible, NO yellow eyes on the back, NO new antenna or mechanical parts. Back of helmet retains the rounded sculptural volume and felt material. The flower pin remains on the front and is not visible from the rear. Neutral upright pose for sitting in a convertible, hands forward out of view, torso and head aligned forward. Camera slightly elevated but predominantly straight rear view. Full body isolated, centered in a square canvas, occupies about 80% of canvas height, preserve reference scale and margins, no clipping. Soft natural daylight, photographic needle-felt texture, not flat illustration, no text, no logos, no ground, no drawn drop shadow. TRUE transparent alpha background.
